<style>
/* =============================================================
   SCOPED RESET --- nukes Shopify Dawn theme overrides
   all:initial applies to wrapper ONLY (proven pattern from live
   AP Cyber pages). Applying it to all descendants kills nested
   element display values (table cells, buttons, inline-block badges).
   ============================================================= */
#apcsa-lesson {
  all: initial !important;
  display: block !important;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif !important;
  max-width: 1080px !important;
  margin: 0 auto !important;
  padding: 32px 20px 80px !important;
  color: #1f2937 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1f2937 !important;
  line-height: 1.65 !important;
  font-size: 17px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson * {
  box-sizing: border-box !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson p, #apcsa-lesson li, #apcsa-lesson td, #apcsa-lesson th,
#apcsa-lesson dt, #apcsa-lesson dd, #apcsa-lesson span, #apcsa-lesson em, #apcsa-lesson strong {
  color: #1f2937 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1f2937 !important;
  font-size: 17px !important;
  line-height: 1.65 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson em { font-style: italic !important; }
#apcsa-lesson strong { font-weight: 700 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson p { margin: 0 0 16px 0 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson ul, #apcsa-lesson ol { display: block !important; margin: 0 0 16px 24px !important; padding: 0 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson ul li { display: list-item !important; list-style: disc outside !important; margin: 0 0 6px 0 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson ol li { display: list-item !important; list-style: decimal outside !important; margin: 0 0 6px 0 !important; }

/* Headings */
#apcsa-lesson h1, #apcsa-lesson h2, #apcsa-lesson h3, #apcsa-lesson h4 {
  display: block !important;
  font-weight: 800 !important;
  color: #0f172a !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #0f172a !important;
  line-height: 1.25 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson h1 { font-size: 36px !important; margin: 8px 0 12px 0 !important; letter-spacing: -0.02em !important; }
#apcsa-lesson h2 { font-size: 26px !important; margin: 40px 0 14px 0 !important; padding-bottom: 8px !important; border-bottom: 2px solid #e5e7eb !important; }
#apcsa-lesson h3 { font-size: 20px !important; margin: 24px 0 10px 0 !important; color: #1e3a8a !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #1e3a8a !important; }
#apcsa-lesson h4 { font-size: 17px !important; margin: 16px 0 8px 0 !important; }

/* Links */

  -webkit-text-fill-color: #2563eb !important;

}

  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1d4ed8 !important;
}

/* Code (used sparingly in conceptual lessons --- only for syntax mentions) */
#apcsa-lesson code {
  font-family: "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, Monaco, monospace !important;
  background: #f1f5f9 !important;
  color: #0f172a !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #0f172a !important;
  padding: 2px 6px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson pre {
  display: block !important;
  background: #0f172a !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;

  padding: 18px 20px !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;

  margin: 16px 0 !important;

  font-size: 14px !important;
  line-height: 1.55 !important;
  white-space: pre !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson pre code {
  background: transparent !important;
  color: #e2e8f0 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #e2e8f0 !important;

  font-size: 14px !important;
}

/* BREADCRUMB */

  margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

  color: #64748b !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #64748b !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-breadcrumb a:hover { text-decoration: underline !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-breadcrumb span.sep { margin: 0 8px !important; color: #cbd5e1 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #cbd5e1 !important; }

/* HEADER */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-header { display: block !important; margin-bottom: 28px !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-eyebrow {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: #dbeafe !important;
  color: #1e40af !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1e40af !important;
  padding: 5px 12px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.05em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-bottom: 12px !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-meta-row {
  display: flex !important;
  gap: 16px !important;
  flex-wrap: wrap !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: #64748b !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #64748b !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-meta-row span { color: #64748b !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #64748b !important; }

/* "WHAT YOU'LL LEARN" BOX */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-learn-box {
  display: block !important;
  background: #eff6ff !important;
  border-left: 4px solid #2563eb !important;
  padding: 20px 24px !important;
  margin: 24px 0 !important;
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-learn-box h3 {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  color: #1e3a8a !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1e3a8a !important;
  font-size: 18px !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-learn-box ul li { margin-bottom: 8px !important; }

/* CALLOUTS */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout {
  display: block !important;
  padding: 18px 22px !important;
  margin: 20px 0 !important;
  border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0 !important;
  border-left: 4px solid #94a3b8 !important;
  background: #f8fafc !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout h4 {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.concept { background: #eff6ff !important; border-left-color: #2563eb !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.concept h4 { color: #1e3a8a !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #1e3a8a !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.example { background: #f0fdf4 !important; border-left-color: #16a34a !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.example h4 { color: #166534 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #166534 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.warning { background: #fef2f2 !important; border-left-color: #dc2626 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.warning h4 { color: #991b1b !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #991b1b !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.trap { background: #fef2f2 !important; border-left-color: #dc2626 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-callout.trap h4 { color: #991b1b !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #991b1b !important; }

/* PRACTICE TIER */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-practice-tier {
  display: block !important;
  background: #fafafa !important;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 24px 28px !important;
  margin: 32px 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-practice-tier h2 {
  margin-top: 0 !important;
  border-bottom: none !important;
  padding-bottom: 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-practice-tier .tier-label {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: #1e40af !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 4px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-right: 10px !important;
}

/* MCQ */
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex {
  display: block !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  padding: 20px 22px !important;
  margin: 16px 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-stem { margin-bottom: 12px !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-stem strong { color: #0f172a !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #0f172a !important; }

/* MCQ options */
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-options { display: block !important; margin: 12px 0 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt {
  display: block !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  margin: 6px 0 !important;
  border: 2px solid #e5e7eb !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  background: #ffffff !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  font-size: 16px !important;
  color: #1f2937 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1f2937 !important;
  transition: all 0.15s !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt:hover { border-color: #93c5fd !important; background: #eff6ff !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt.selected { border-color: #2563eb !important; background: #dbeafe !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt.correct { border-color: #16a34a !important; background: #dcfce7 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt.incorrect { border-color: #dc2626 !important; background: #fee2e2 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-opt-letter {
  display: inline-block !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  margin-right: 10px !important;
  color: #1e40af !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1e40af !important;
}

/* Predict gate */
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-predict-gate {
  display: block !important;
  background: #fffbeb !important;
  border-left: 3px solid #f59e0b !important;
  padding: 10px 14px !important;
  margin: 10px 0 !important;
  font-size: 14px !important;
  color: #78350f !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #78350f !important;
  font-style: italic !important;
}

/* Buttons */
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-btn,
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-btn:link,
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-btn:visited {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: #2563eb !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 10px 20px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  font-weight: 600 !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  border: none !important;
  cursor: pointer !important;
  margin: 4px 4px 4px 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-btn:hover, #apcsa-lesson .apcs-btn:active {
  background: #1d4ed8 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
}

/* Feedback */
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-feedback {
  display: none !important;
  margin-top: 12px !important;
  padding: 14px 16px !important;
  border-radius: 6px !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-feedback.show { display: block !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-feedback.fb-correct {
  background: #dcfce7 !important;
  border-left: 4px solid #16a34a !important;
  color: #14532d !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #14532d !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcs-ex-feedback.fb-incorrect {
  background: #fee2e2 !important;
  border-left: 4px solid #dc2626 !important;
  color: #7f1d1d !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #7f1d1d !important;
}

/* MASTERY */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery {
  display: block !important;
  background: #0f172a !important;
  color: #f1f5f9 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #f1f5f9 !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 32px 32px 28px !important;
  margin: 40px 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery,
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery p,
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery span,
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery li,
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery strong,
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery em { color: #f1f5f9 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #f1f5f9 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery code { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10) !important; color: #fde68a !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #fde68a !important; padding: 2px 6px !important; border-radius: 4px !important; font-size: 14px !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-feedback.fb-correct strong { color: #14532d !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #14532d !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-feedback.fb-correct code { background: rgba(20,83,45,0.12) !important; color: #14532d !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #14532d !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-feedback.fb-incorrect strong { color: #7f1d1d !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #7f1d1d !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-feedback.fb-incorrect code { background: rgba(127,29,29,0.12) !important; color: #7f1d1d !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #7f1d1d !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .mastery-badge {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: #f59e0b !important;
  color: #0f172a !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #0f172a !important;
  padding: 5px 12px !important;
  border-radius: 999px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  margin-bottom: 14px !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery h2 { color: #ffffff !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important; border-bottom: none !important; padding-bottom: 0 !important; margin-top: 0 !important; }

  background: #1e293b !important;
  border-color: #334155 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-stem,
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-stem strong { color: #f1f5f9 !important; -webkit-text-fill-color: #f1f5f9 !important; }
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt {
  background: #0f172a !important;
  border-color: #334155 !important;
  color: #f1f5f9 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #f1f5f9 !important;
}

#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .apcs-ex-options .apcs-opt.selected { border-color: #60a5fa !important; background: #1e3a8a !important; }

  display: block !important;
  margin-top: 18px !important;
  padding: 16px 18px !important;
  background: #1e293b !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  border: 1px solid #334155 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .mastery-rubric h4 {
  color: #fbbf24 !important;

  margin-bottom: 10px !important;
  font-size: 15px !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .rubric-row {
  display: flex !important;

#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-mastery .rubric-score {
  display: inline-block !important;

  color: #ffffff !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 3px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  white-space: nowrap !important;
}

/* EXTENSION */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-extension {
  display: block !important;
  background: #faf5ff !important;
  border: 1px solid #e9d5ff !important;
  border-radius: 12px !important;
  padding: 24px 28px !important;
  margin: 32px 0 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-extension h3 {
  color: #6b21a8 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #6b21a8 !important;
  margin-top: 8px !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-extension .ext-badge {
  display: inline-block !important;
  background: #6b21a8 !important;
  color: #ffffff !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #ffffff !important;
  padding: 4px 10px !important;
  border-radius: 4px !important;
  font-size: 11px !important;
  font-weight: 700 !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em !important;
  text-transform: uppercase !important;
}

/* NAV */
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-lesson-nav {
  display: flex !important;
  justify-content: space-between !important;
  gap: 14px !important;
  margin: 40px 0 24px 0 !important;
  padding-top: 24px !important;
  border-top: 2px solid #e5e7eb !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-lesson-nav a:link, #apcsa-lesson .apcsa-lesson-nav a:visited {
  display: block !important;
  flex: 1 1 0 !important;
  padding: 14px 18px !important;
  background: #f8fafc !important;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb !important;
  border-radius: 8px !important;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: #1f2937 !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: #1f2937 !important;
}
#apcsa-lesson .apcsa-lesson-nav a:hover { border-color: #2563eb !important; background: #eff6ff !important; }

  #apcsa-lesson { padding: 20px 16px 60px !important; font-size: 16px !important; }

}

}

<div class="apcsa-callout concept" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#ede9fe!important;border-left:4px solid #7c3aed!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#1e1b4b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e1b4b!important;">CED EK 3.6.A.1–3.6.A.3</h4>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">When an object reference is passed, the parameter receives a COPY of the reference -- both the caller and parameter point to the SAME object (EK 3.6.A.1). A method CAN change a mutable object's state. When a method returns an object reference, the caller receives a reference to the SAME object (EK 3.6.A.2). A method CANNOT access private data of a parameter unless the parameter is the same type as the enclosing class (EK 3.6.A.3).</p>
</div>
<h2 style="font-size:22px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#1e1b4b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e1b4b!important;margin:32px 0 12px!important;">How Object References Are Passed</h2>
<div class="apcsa-callout example" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;border-left:4px solid #16a34a!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#15803d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#15803d!important;">Mutating a Passed Object</h4>
<pre style="margin:8px 0 0!important;background:#1e293b!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;padding:14px!important;border-radius:6px!important;font-size:13px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;">public class Baker {
    public void fillJar(Jar j) {
        j.addCookies(10);  // changes the SAME jar
    }
}
Jar myJar = new Jar(5);
new Baker().fillJar(myJar);
System.out.println(myJar.getCookies());  // 15</pre>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">j is a copy of the reference -- points to the SAME jar. Calling j.addCookies(10) mutates the shared object.</p>
</div>
<h2 style="font-size:22px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#1e1b4b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e1b4b!important;margin:32px 0 12px!important;">Aliasing</h2>
<div class="apcsa-callout example" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;border-left:4px solid #16a34a!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#15803d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#15803d!important;">Two Variables, One Object</h4>
<pre style="margin:8px 0 0!important;background:#1e293b!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;padding:14px!important;border-radius:6px!important;font-size:13px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;">Jar jar1 = new Jar(5);
Jar jar2 = jar1;  // alias!
jar2.addCookies(10);
System.out.println(jar1.getCookies());  // 15, not 5</pre>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">jar2 = jar1 makes both point to the same Jar. Changes through jar2 are visible through jar1.</p>
</div>
<div class="apcsa-callout trap" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#fef3c7!important;border-left:4px solid #d97706!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#92400e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#92400e!important;">AP Trap: Object Parameter vs Primitive Parameter</h4>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">Primitives: copy of value -- caller unaffected. Objects: copy of reference -- SAME object is reachable; state CAN be changed.</p>
</div>
<div class="apcsa-callout trap" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#fef3c7!important;border-left:4px solid #d97706!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#92400e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#92400e!important;">AP Trap: Reassigning Parameter Reference Doesn't Affect Caller</h4>
<pre style="margin:8px 0 0!important;background:#1e293b!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;padding:14px!important;border-radius:6px!important;font-size:13px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;">public void replaceJar(Jar j) {
    j = new Jar(100);  // replaces local copy only
}
Jar myJar = new Jar(5);
replaceJar(myJar);
// myJar still has 5 cookies</pre>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">Reassigning j to a new Jar replaces the LOCAL reference copy. myJar in the caller is unaffected. This is DIFFERENT from calling a mutator method on j.</p>
</div>
<div class="apcsa-callout trap" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#fef3c7!important;border-left:4px solid #d97706!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#92400e!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#92400e!important;">AP Trap: Cannot Access Another Class's Private Data</h4>
<pre style="margin:8px 0 0!important;background:#1e293b!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;padding:14px!important;border-radius:6px!important;font-size:13px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;">public class Baker {
    public void inspect(Jar j) {
        System.out.println(j.cookies);  // COMPILE ERROR
    }
}</pre>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">EK 3.6.A.3: Baker != Jar. Baker cannot access Jar's private fields directly.</p>
</div>
<h2 style="font-size:22px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#1e1b4b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e1b4b!important;margin:32px 0 12px!important;">Same-Class Private Access (EK 3.6.A.3)</h2>
<div class="apcsa-callout example" style="margin:20px 0!important;padding:16px 20px!important;background:#f0fdf4!important;border-left:4px solid #16a34a!important;border-radius:6px!important;">
<h4 style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:15px!important;color:#15803d!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#15803d!important;">Valid Same-Class Access</h4>
<pre style="margin:8px 0 0!important;background:#1e293b!important;color:#e2e8f0!important;padding:14px!important;border-radius:6px!important;font-size:13px!important;overflow-x:auto!important;">public class Point {
    private int x; private int y;
    public boolean equals(Point other) {
        return this.x == other.x && this.y == other.y;
        // other.x is valid: other is also a Point
    }
}</pre>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">A method inside Point CAN access other.x and other.y because other is also a Point.</p>
</div>
<p style="margin:0 0 8px!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;"><strong>Real-World Connection:</strong> Passing a BankAccount to a transfer() method lets it call account.withdraw() -- mutating the same account. Powerful but requires careful design.</p>
<div class="apcsa-block" style="margin:28px 0!important;">
<h3 style="font-size:17px!important;font-weight:700!important;color:#1e1b4b!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#1e1b4b!important;margin:0 0 10px!important;">Summary</h3>
<ul style="padding-left:20px!important;margin:0!important;">
<li style="margin:4px 0!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">When an object reference is passed, the parameter is a COPY of the reference; both point to the SAME object (EK 3.6.A.1).</li>
<li style="margin:4px 0!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">A method CAN change a mutable object passed as a parameter by calling its mutators.</li>
<li style="margin:4px 0!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">Reassigning the parameter reference does NOT affect the caller's variable.</li>
<li style="margin:4px 0!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">Returned reference points to the SAME object (EK 3.6.A.2).</li>
<li style="margin:4px 0!important;font-size:14px!important;color:#374151!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#374151!important;">Same-class: method can access private fields of a same-type parameter. Different class: compile error (EK 3.6.A.3).</li>
</ul>
</div>
